purpose: Compare V4 simulations with published measurements. This is a check of the model, never a fit.

rules.no_tuning: No model, catalogue, thermal or solver value may change because of these results.
rules.keep_poor_results: Every case is reported, including poor matches, refusals and early stops.
rules.wording: Say 'compared with published measurements'. Never say 'validated'.
rules.claims: A case outside its band must be stated as an over- or under-prediction wherever its chart is used.
rules.reserved_records: Samsung final-assessment UDDS and Imperial Cell 2 stay closed. configs/splits.json final_assessment and quarantine records stay closed.

shared_method.model: Deployed LG_M50T_ECN from configs/cell_catalogue_v2.json, one identical instance per cell. Published same-cell-type tables, not per-cell fits.
shared_method.thermal: Deployed defaults: 58.5 J/K per cell, 0.1525 W/K cooling, wire heat fraction 0.5, no cell-to-cell thermal contacts. Not adjusted for either rig.
shared_method.starting_charge: Invert the model OCV at the measured rested voltage on the last rest sample before discharge, at the mean measured surface temperature. Same value for every cell. Capped at 100%.
shared_method.starting_temperature: Measured surface temperature of each channel at the first discharge sample.
shared_method.ambient: Mean measured chamber temperature over the discharge step, held constant. Its measured range is reported.
shared_method.alignment: Zero time is the first discharge sample. No time shift. Simulation is interpolated to measured timestamps up to the earlier of the step end and the simulation end.
shared_method.temperature_meaning: The model has one lumped temperature per cell. Sensors read the surface. This difference is a limitation, not corrected.

temperature.peak_rise_error: abs(error) <= max(1 K, 25% of measured rise)
temperature.source: Indicative band declared here before any comparison. It labels the result and establishes no accuracy claim.

comparisons.cell_identity: Exact LG INR21700-M50T, four cells, positions P17 P4 P10 P16
comparisons.independence: No catalogue or cooling value was fitted to this record. It was inspected earlier for electrical reconciliation and comes from the same rig as test 53, so it is not a blind holdout.
comparisons.topology: 1s4p same-side ladder, both outputs at cell 1
comparisons.link_basis: The dataset's added 3 mOhm per segment. The rig's own baseline resistance is unknown and is not fitted.
comparisons.current: Mean cycler current over step 5, held constant

sensitivities.change: Mean of the four author Hall branches replaces the cycler current
sensitivities.reason: The cycler and Hall sum disagree by about 1.5 A. This remains unresolved.
